dataList.content: Are you the Floor Manager of B2F?

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: You've found them. We are spinners of thread, and we manage this floor.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: Tell me what it is you seek.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: If your wish does not fall out of step with the voice of fate, I shall grant it.
We have accepted a commission from Le Noir and come to make a Golden Skein.
The Floor Manager regarded the Authenticity Certificate Meursault produced with little interest—until the cocoon caught their eye, and a broad smile spread across their lips.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: A Golden Cocoon... You have brought me a precious material—that of a being of eld.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: But... there's something missing.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: I could spin fine thread from this... but the cocoon alone cannot yield the Golden Skein.
<The recipe didn't list anything else... Do we need another ingredient?>
... What? Need a G.B. or something?
She is asking whether a Golden Bough is required, Manager.
Tsk... G.B. means Golden Buildingskin, not Golden Bough.
... I see.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: I assume you mean the Golden Hide. It is not a suitable medium for coloring thread, child.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: Go to the Dyehouse and fetch the Golden Dye.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: Palette has been gathering it with great care, one drop at a time.
... I expect this will cost another mountain of eyeballs.
<At least spending them raises our Prestige Tier.>
<We'll eventually be allowed onto the upper floors if we keep this up...>
<Let's go to the Dyehouse.>
